subject: Web Development
title: Serverless at the Edge
description: A quick win: understand Serverless at the Edge.

hook.text: Serverless functions run code on demand. Edge moves them to servers near each user.

buildup.text: Together, serverless-at-the-edge means instant global deployment with zero infrastructure.

discovery.text: Platforms like Cloudflare Workers spin up code in under 5 milliseconds worldwide.

twist.text: Edge functions can't run long processes or hold persistent connections easily.

climax.text: Serverless edge is perfect for APIs, auth checks, and personalization — the web's fast lane.

punchline.text: Code runs everywhere in under 5 milliseconds.

quiz.question: What is serverless at the edge?
options: On-demand code running near each user globally
